description.text: Monitors selected systemd services that should remain running. Discovery does not select services automatically.

monitored_services_help.text: Select only services that should remain running on this server. Oneshot and demand-activated services cannot be selected. Discovery never selects a service automatically.

interval_seconds_help.text: Time between observations. A stop and restart between observations may be missed.

alert_after_seconds_help.text: Confirm unhealthy state in two distinct observations separated by this delay. Zero alerts from the first observation after startup grace. Collection and delivery add time.

startup_grace_seconds_help.text: Time after server boot before an unhealthy service can become critical. This does not report stopped services as healthy.

inventory_limit.text: Discovery reached its limit. Selected services are checked separately.

inventory_unavailable.text: Service discovery is incomplete. Selected services are checked separately.

ineligible.text: This service is a oneshot, retained-exit, template or demand-activated unit.

not_readable.text: Service properties could not be read.

pending_reason.text: {service} is {state}; waiting for fresh confirmation or startup grace.

unknown_reason.text: {service} needs review or a readable current state.
